result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out, but one section heading shows a raw localization key instead of user-facing text.

issues.description: The section heading above the ramen card displays the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a translated title.
issues.suggestion: Resolve the localization key so the section shows its intended title (e.g., 'Popular near you') and add a fallback so missing translations never render raw keys.
